title: Labuh Gaun Dia
subject: a dressmaker pins the hem of his fiancée's wedding gown on his knees while she insists on wearing sneakers underneath, so he lets the hem change at every fitting
caption: Argentine cuarteto cordobes dance, tunga-tunga bounce with a driving tropical swing. Bright piano-style keyboard montuno riffs, punchy electric bass on the offbeat, congas and timbales, scraped guiro, short brass stabs. Dance-hall mix, lively and close. Male tenor lead, bright and warm, cheerful lilt. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, A minor. Joyful, teasing, romantic mood. No electronic drop, no autotune, no rap, no reggaeton dembow, no slow ballad.
lyrics:
[Intro - keyboard riff, congas and timbales join]

[Verse 1]
Aku melutut atas lantai butik
Peniti dalam mulut, pita ukur di leher
Dia berdiri atas bangku kecil
Kasut sukan putih, di bawah gaun

[Pre-Chorus]
Abang, panjang lagi sikit
Abang, pendek lagi sikit

[Chorus]
Labuh gaun dia, tiap minggu lain
Aku jahit semula, aku tak kisah
Asal dia senyum, asal dia sayang
Labuh gaun dia, aku ikut dia

[Verse 2]
Minggu ini dia nak gaun senang menari
Minggu depan dia nak gaun senang berlari
Aku tanya, kenapa tak pakai kasut tinggi
Dia kata, nanti aku tersandung

[Bridge - keyboard and percussion break]
Satu, dua, tiga, ukur lagi
Peniti jatuh, dia ketawa

[Chorus]
Labuh gaun dia, tiap minggu lain
Aku jahit semula, aku tak kisah
Asal dia senyum, asal dia sayang
Labuh gaun dia, kasut sukan pun naik pelamin

[Outro - brass stabs and congas, keyboard riff out]
Aku ikut dia
